description: This file implements the Watchdog Management (WdgM) module for an AUTOSAR platform, including initialization, mode setting, alive supervision, and trigger handling.

methods.name: WdgM_UpdateAliveCounter
methods.description: Increments the alive counter for a supervised entity if supervision is active.

methods.name: WdgM_ActivateAliveSupervision
methods.description: Activates alive supervision for a specified entity.

methods.name: WdgM_DeactivateAliveSupervision
methods.description: Deactivates alive supervision for a specified entity.

methods.name: WdgM_GetAliveSupervisionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the supervision status of a specific entity.

methods.name: WdgM_GetGlobalStatus
methods.description: Returns the overall global supervision status.

methods.name: WdgM_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the watchdog manager, adjusting supervision accordingly.

methods.name: WdgM_GetMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current mode of the watchdog manager.

methods.name: WdgM_Init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog management module with configuration data.

methods.name: WdgM_MainFunction_Trigger
methods.description: Triggers watchdogs based on the current mode and supervision status.

methods.name: WdgM_Cbk_GptNotification
methods.description: Callback invoked upon GPT timer notification to perform supervision and trigger actions.

methods.name: WdgM_Arc_GetAliveSupervisionPtr
methods.description: Returns pointer to the alive supervision configuration for a mode.

methods.name: WdgM_Arc_GetSupervisionPtr
methods.description: Returns pointer to the supervision state of an entity.
